issue.title: `ros2_control_node` fails to start up on Windows/RoboStack in Jazzy or newer
issue.body:
**Describe the bug**
On RoboStack + Pixi + Windows, `ros2_control_node` crashes in Jazzy and newer.

**To Reproduce**
Make a simple Pixi environment in Windows with this as your `pixi.toml`.

```toml
[workspace]
channels = ["conda-forge", "https://prefix.dev/robostack-jazzy"]
platforms = ["win-64"]

[dependencies]
ros-jazzy-ros-base = "*"
ros-jazzy-controller-manager = "*"
```

Then, run `pixi shell` and `ros2 run controller_manager ros2_control_node`.

You get this:

```
(roboplan-ros) PS C:\test> ros2 run controller_manager ros2_control_node
[INFO] [1784861884.280229500] [controller_manager]: Using Steady (Monotonic) clock for triggering controller manager cycles.
[INFO] [1784861884.287362000] [controller_manager]: Subscribing to '/robot_description' topic for robot description.
[ros2run]: Process exited with failure 3221225477
```

**Expected behavior**
Swap out Jazzy for Humble and you get correct behavior.

```
(roboplan-ros) PS C:\test> ros2 run controller_manager ros2_control_node
[WARN] [1784862048.093321600] [controller_manager]: 'update_rate' parameter not set, using default value.
[INFO] [1784862048.093449300] [controller_manager]: Subscribing to '~/robot_description' topic for robot description file.
Realtime kernel detection is not supported on Windows.
[INFO] [1784862048.094867600] [controller_manager]: update rate is 100 Hz
[INFO] [1784862048.094932100] [controller_manager]: Spawning controller_manager RT thread with scheduler priority: 50
[WARN] [1784862048.095075200] [controller_manager]: Could not enable FIFO RT scheduling policy: with error number <0>(No error). See [https://control.ros.org/master/doc/ros2_control/controller_manager/doc/userdoc.html] for details on how to enable realtime scheduling.

# at this point, the node is running...
```

**Environment (please complete the following information):**
 - OS: Windows
 - Version: Jazzy
 - Pixi + RoboStack

**Additional context**

I don't know what it might be... but given where this line appears, my first guess would be it has to do with the `realtime_tools` stuff, since we don't even get to the print statement about realtime kernel not being supported on Windows.

https://github.com/ros-controls/realtime_tools/blob/0e0bca049675fa6da1579d4fc4d83b10a564b9ab/realtime_tools/src/realtime_helpers.cpp#L52

called by

https://github.com/ros-controls/ros2_control/blob/4bcce091c25d1412bb52261479fd57607a93c021/controller_manager/src/ros2_control_node.cpp#L63

... that or the instantiation of controller manager right above: https://github.com/ros-controls/ros2_control/blob/4bcce091c25d1412bb52261479fd57607a93c021/controller_manager/src/ros2_control_node.cpp#L58-L59

https://github.com/ros-controls/realtime_tools/blob/0e0bca049675fa6da1579d4fc4d83b10a564b9ab/realtime_tools/src/realtime_helpers.cpp#L52

called by

ros2_control/controller_manager/src/ros2_control_node.cpp

Line 63 in 4bcce09

const bool has_realtime = realtime_tools::has_realtime_kernel();

... that or the instantiation of controller manager right above:

ros2_control/controller_manager/src/ros2_control_node.cpp

Lines 58 to 59 in 4bcce09

auto cm = std::make_shared<controller_manager::ControllerManager>(
executor, manager_node_name, "", cm_node_options);

comments.body: Thanks for reporting. I was able to reproduce it, it happens somewhere about creation of the introspection publisher thread. let's see if copilot finds the root cause
comments.bodyHTML: Thanks for reporting. I was able to reproduce it, it happens somewhere about creation of the introspection publisher thread. let's see if copilot finds the root cause

This is fixed with pal-robotics/pal_statistics#26
@saikishor can you have a look please?

A local alternative would be


diff --git a/controller_manager/src/controller_manager.cpp b/controller_manager/src/controller_manager.cpp
index 33e02d93..2b5a7801 100644
--- a/controller_manager/src/controller_manager.cpp
+++ b/controller_manager/src/controller_manager.cpp
@@ -690,13 +690,34 @@ void ControllerManager::init_controller_manager()
     "Controller Manager Activity", this,
     &ControllerManager::controller_manager_diagnostic_callback);
 
-  INITIALIZE_ROS2_CONTROL_INTROSPECTION_REGISTRY(
+  auto default_registry_from_create = pal_statistics::getOrCreateRegistry(
     this, hardware_interface::DEFAULT_INTROSPECTION_TOPIC,
     hardware_interface::DEFAULT_REGISTRY_KEY);
-  START_ROS2_CONTROL_INTROSPECTION_PUBLISHER_THREAD(hardware_interface::DEFAULT_REGISTRY_KEY);
-  INITIALIZE_ROS2_CONTROL_INTROSPECTION_REGISTRY(
+  if (default_registry_from_create)
+  {
+    default_registry_from_create->startPublishThread();
+  }
+  else
+  {
+    RCLCPP_WARN(
+      get_logger(),
+      "Unable to initialize introspection registry '%s'; skipping introspection publisher thread.",
+      hardware_interface::DEFAULT_REGISTRY_KEY);
+  }
+
+  auto cm_stats_registry_from_create = pal_statistics::getOrCreateRegistry(
     this, hardware_interface::CM_STATISTICS_TOPIC, hardware_interface::CM_STATISTICS_KEY);
-  START_ROS2_CONTROL_INTROSPECTION_PUBLISHER_THREAD(hardware_interface::CM_STATISTICS_KEY);
+  if (cm_stats_registry_from_create)
+  {
+    cm_stats_registry_from_create->startPublishThread();
+  }
+  else
+  {
+    RCLCPP_WARN(
+      get_logger(),
+      "Unable to initialize introspection registry '%s'; skipping introspection publisher thread.",
+      hardware_interface::CM_STATISTICS_KEY);
+  }
 
   // Add on_shutdown callback to stop the controller manager
   rclcpp::Context::SharedPtr context = this->get_node_base_interface()->get_context();

comments.body: @christophfroehlich @sea-bass happy to accept pull request adding the required patch in RoboStack
